444:t_007:19.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「He told you the truth of the $$黒歴史$$ during the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$.」

444:t_007:20.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「But now that Earth faces a crisis, there is something we must confirm with $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$.」

444:t_007:22.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「A further truth... What might be called the darkness of the $$黒歴史$$.」

444:t_008:1.en:
$$シュレード$$
「He's no longer anywhere in the facility. It seems the truth $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ tells was inconvenient for him too.」

444:t_008:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「That guy... does he plan to come at us just for kicks...!?」

444:t_008:3.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「It's pointless to expect logic from $$ミカゲ$$!」

444:t_009:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Like hell I'll let that $$頭翅#pilot$$ look-alike take out $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$!」

444:t_010:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This is... the authorization of the microwave transmission facilities for the $$サテライトキャノン$$...」

444:t_010:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Awesome! If we're linked to this many transmission facilities, the microwaves will reach us within a minute no matter where we are!」

444:t_010:2.en:
$$パーラ$$
「So it makes no difference whether the Moon is out or not!」

444:t_010:3.en:
$$ティファ$$
($$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ is going to help us...)

444:t_010:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$...? I can feel $$ティファ$$ close to me, even though she should be on the ship...」

444:t_010:5.en:
$$ティファ$$
(I'll fight together with $$ガロード$$, too... Take my heart with you as well.)

444:t_010:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「With $$ティファ$$ by my side, I've got the strength of a hundred! Here we come, $$堕天翅$$ army!」

444:t_010:7.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Captain $$ハリー$$! Please look after $$ディアナ$$!」

444:t_010:8.en:
$$ハリー$$
「Understood! Leave things here to me!」

444:t_010:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Everyone, watch out! $$ミカゲ$$ has to be somewhere close!」

444:t_010:10.en:
$$ミコノ$$
(That person... using the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ again...)

444:t_012:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「Is that the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ that $$アポロ$$ used to ride!?」

444:t_012:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The time of the true battle is drawing near... Let's see whether you're of any use.」

444:t_013:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Wingless have no need to know the truth. I have no intention of taking on needless risk.」

444:t_014:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I won't let you do that.」

444:t_015:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Moon is beautiful when viewed from Earth... But once you land on the Moon's wasteland like this, you learn it is a world of nothingness, with nothing there.」

444:t_015:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Wingless, who have no wings, should have been content to live on that beautiful planet.」

444:t_015:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is that why you would destroy the Moon!?」

444:t_015:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's right. By now, the palace where the Moon Queen lives is probably wrapped in flames too.」

444:t_015:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「What a terrible thing you've done!」

444:t_015:6.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$ロラン・セアック$$, there is no need to deal with him.」

444:t_015:8.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「It is true that our ancestors defiled the Earth and came to this world of nothing...」

444:t_015:9.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「But there, we brought forth new life and passed that life on to the next generation.」

444:t_015:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Nonsense, Moon Queen. Those who feared evolution and closed off their own future with their own hands have no right to say such things.」

444:t_015:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Are you talking about the $$月光蝶$$ of the $$ホワイトドール$$!?」

444:t_015:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's right. The Gundam you ride, with the wings of a butterfly, is a symbol of destruction.」

444:t_015:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There is no future beyond that Gundam. It is a terminus that closes off everything.」

444:t_015:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's wrong! The $$月光蝶$$ may well have destroyed a civilization, but humanity didn't end there!」

444:t_015:15.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Everyone is alive! And the $$ホワイトドール$$ can create a future too, with the power to protect them!」

444:t_015:16.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$ロラン・セアック$$... As you are now, you will be able to use the power of the $$月光蝶$$ correctly.」

444:t_015:17.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「To you, who can still believe in the $$ホワイトドール$$ and the future even after learning the darkness of the $$黒歴史$$, I entrust all of the $$月光蝶$$.」

444:t_016:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The seal on the $$月光蝶$$ system is being released...」

444:t_016:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ターンエー$$! You are going to protect the future too!!」

444:t_017:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The $$月光蝶$$ is absorbing the enemy units' energy!」

444:t_017:1.en:
$$レド$$
「The same effect as the nanomachines of $$ガルガンティア$$!」

444:t_017:2.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「The Verdurous Star Worms, created to remove ocean pollution, have the power to absorb energy and release electrical energy.」

444:t_017:3.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「The $$月光蝶$$, which was developed from them, retains those functions as well, in addition to its power to break down matter.」

444:t_017:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'm sure that's the work of people who believed that someday even the $$月光蝶$$ would be used as a power to restore the Earth.」

444:t_018:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The terminus of the civilization of fire... So you will unleash that power.」

444:t_018:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Shut up, fake $$頭翅#pilot$$! Once I've dealt with you and the black $$アクエリオン$$, we're heading for the city on the Moon!」

444:t_019:0.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Leave that fight to us.」

444:t_019:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「I knew it, you're still alive!」

444:t_019:3.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「We are working with the $$宇宙革命軍$$ of the colonies to fight the $$サイデリアル$$ around $$翠の地球$$.」

444:t_019:4.en:
$$ウィッツ$$
「That's right! Don't go deciding on your own that we died!」

444:t_019:5.en:
$$ロアビィ$$
「We'll do our thing on our side, so we're counting on you to do yours, $c!」

444:t_019:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ウィッツ$$! $$ロアビィ$$!」

444:t_019:7.en:
$$ロアビィ$$
「Looks like you haven't changed either, $$ガロード$$. Keep doing your best with $$ティファ$$, nice and close.」

444:t_019:8.en:
$$ウィッツ$$
「$$トニヤ$$, $$サラ$$, $$シンゴ$$, $$キッド$$, the Doctor, and $$エニル$$ are all doing great!」

444:t_019:9.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「$$ガロード$$... You, $$パーラ$$ and $$ティファ$$ represent $$フリーデン$$. I'm counting on you.」

444:t_019:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah! Leave it to me!」

444:t_019:12.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「You are a pitiable being.」

444:t_019:14.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「You are like me... By living for eternity, you have forgotten the wonder of humans, whose lives are limited.」

444:t_019:15.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Humans have no eternity... That is why, through the mingling of people with people, they connect the past to the future.」
